question: In November 2024, Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT) signed an agreement with which Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) for development of ‘Millimeter Wave Transceiver for 5G Rural Connectivity’, which aims to enable affordable broadband and mobile services across India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**IIT Roorkee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT)** signed an agreement with **IIT Roorkee** in **November 2024** to collaborate on the development of the **'Millimeter Wave Transceiver for 5G Rural Connectivity'**.
 
• The collaboration is focused on enabling **affordable broadband and mobile services** across rural parts of India.
 
• The **'Millimeter Wave Transceiver'** is crucial for improving **5G network coverage** in rural and remote regions.
 
• IIT Roorkee is known for its excellence in **telecommunications research** and has been actively engaged in projects related to **5G technology**.
 
• Millimeter wave technology operates at high frequencies, offering **high data rates** and **low latency**, essential for rural connectivity.
 
• This initiative aligns with the Indian government's vision of **Digital India** by bridging the digital divide between urban and rural areas.
 
• C-DOT, a premier **R&D center under the Department of Telecommunications**, plays a key role in developing indigenous telecom technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IIT Madras**__

 __
 
• **IIT Madras** is a leading institute in India for **engineering and technology research**.
 
• It has been involved in various **telecommunication and 5G-related projects**, such as developing indigenous 5G testbeds.
 
• Located in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**, IIT Madras is recognized for its contributions in **artificial intelligence** and **wireless communication research**.
 
 
 
• **IIT Delhi**__
 __
 
• **IIT Delhi**, based in **New Delhi**, is renowned for its **innovation and research in technology**.
 
• The institute has worked on **5G network design** and **smart city technologies**.
 
• IIT Delhi also plays a key role in India's **startup ecosystem** by incubating tech-based startups.
 
 
 
• **IIT Bombay**__
 
 
• **IIT Bombay**, located in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**, is a top-tier institution for **engineering and applied sciences**.
 
• It has been contributing to **telecom research** and has launched initiatives in **IoT and 5G technologies**.
 
• The institute also collaborates with global tech companies for **advanced communication systems**.
